Rules out: server or daemon, accounts, stored summaries, interactive prompts, concurrency control. | OPEN QUESTIONS (who answers, what it blocks). Ambiguous terms to pin down: 'sales records', 'revenue' (gross or net of discounts, tax, returns), 'units', 'region' (name or code), 'product' (name or SKU), 'summary'. Local environment: python3 version, pytest availability, any sample *.csv in the workspace (the working directory is empty now). Any locator that proves sensitive goes only in an authorized private store, never in KNOWLEDGE/, and real sample data is never committed. | WHERE AND WHEN VISIBLE. The result must become usable as a runnable CLI plus a passing test suite at the root of the run's repository checkout [assumption: the request names no other target, so that is the grant, Q8]. It is visible to the user only after the final return of the isolated run, because until then the source checkout stays at its snapshot (empty). It is not a deployed target, so no release is needed and nothing is published or running anywhere. Within the run it first becomes observable at the implementation and verification stages (the tool run on synthetic CSV and the test output); intake produces only this map and implements nothing."
